reviews.text: Well, this was extremely disappointing. I showed up on a Tuesday at 2 o’clock and it was closed even though the schedule says it’s open and Google says it’s open. I drove a long distance to get here so now I have to find a different puppy shop. It’s not good business when customers come from far away and they find out that their store that’s supposed to be open is closed.

I had an amazing experience buying my Golden Retriever from Hairy’s Puppies World. From the very first moment, the team was super professional and friendly, and you can really tell how much they love dogs. They explained everything about his care, vaccinations, and feeding. My puppy arrived healthy, happy, and full of energy. They definitely have a wonderful and responsible team. I highly recommend them! 🤩
100% recommended!! I bought the most adorable hairy chihuahua!
The puppies here are beautiful, they look well cared for, the seller is patient and shows the puppies until one is satisfied.

I want to thank Hairy's Puppies for helping me choose my puppy. Luna is the best in everything; they deliver your puppies in excellent condition with all their paperwork in order. My puppy is super intelligent and adapted very well and quickly to my home.

I want to thank Hairys Puppies World for the wonderful experience. From the very first moment, it's clear that it's a very clean and organized place, and that they truly care about the well-being of each puppy. All the puppies are very well cared for, healthy, and full of love.

Jorge's attention was excellent; he was always attentive, patient, and willing to answer all our questions. Furthermore, Mrs. Mercedes's care and dedication are clearly reflected in each of the puppies; you can see the love and responsibility with which they work.

We are so grateful to have found Koda, the newest member of our family, here.
Excellent service. If you're looking for a pedigree dog and also need advice on how to care for it, this is the place. 100% recommended.
Jorge and Natalia were super friendly, the places are clean

First time niece buying a puppy and I can say the store is super clean the puppies look well taken care of Jorge is a lovable caretaker, you can Tell they really love the dogs, other stores I have seen are not as clean nor the puppies look as happy. It was a great experience we will definitely come back.
